text: 2026年1-8月，我国服务进出口总额50701.6亿元（人民币，下同），同比增长7.9%。其中，出口19996.1亿元，增长14.8%；进口30705.5亿元，增长3.8%。服务贸易逆差10709.4亿元，同比缩小1451.2亿元。主要呈现以下特点：旅行和运输服务出口对整体服务出口增长的贡献率近50%。知识密集型服务出口占比超过一半。
text_en: From January to August 2026, China's total trade in services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan (RMB, same below), up 7.9% year on year. Among this, exports were 1,999.61 billion yuan, up 14.8%; imports were 3,070.55 billion yuan, up 3.8%. The trade in services deficit was 1,070.94 billion yuan, narrowing by 145.12 billion yuan year on year. It mainly showed the following characteristics: travel and transport service exports contributed nearly 50% to overall service export growth. Knowledge-intensive services accounted for more than half of service exports.
